funding.supported_assets_note: Prepaid USD cards topped up with crypto; the operator SC PAYMENTS LIMITED (Hong Kong) states it 'is not a bank, electronic money institution, or card issuer' and that cards are issued by an unnamed third-party Issuer 'pursuant to a license from Visa'. Top-up networks named on the referral page: Solana and supported EVM networks (commissionable), Bitcoin, Litecoin and Tron (accepted, non-commissionable). Crypto top-ups 'are subject to applicable top-up fees and conversion spread'.

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: Terms: not available to persons in countries under comprehensive UN, US, EU or UK sanctions or on sanctions / restricted-party lists; clients must be at least 18.
eligibility.usage_note: Fee page: 'Not available to residents of Hong Kong. Eligibility may vary by region.' No positive list of supported countries is published; the terms do not restrict the product to one territory and contain no no-solicitation clause. Accounts flagged for 'Hong Kong indicators' may be suspended with balances forfeited.

kyc.thresholds_note: Virtual card: 'the email-only tier', spending limit '$10,000/month'. Platinum card: 'requires identity verification and removes the top-up fee', 'No limit'. Terms: 'Access to certain card types or features requires completion of identity verification'; 'Identity verification may be required for certain card tiers, features, or spending limits.' No amount threshold is published.
kyc.stages_note: Ordering a Virtual card: email account (operator's wording: 'email-only tier'). Ordering a Platinum card, or accessing certain features or limits: identity verification. Documents required for verification are not listed on the pages read. This record describes only what the operator states.

access.note: No monthly or annual fee; a one-time $10 issuance fee per card and a 5% top-up fee apply.

fees.conditions: 'a one-time $10 issuance fee for each new card' (fee schedule current as of 15 August 2026).

'Monthly account fee: None', 'Annual fee: None' (fee schedule); terms: 'no monthly fee for active accounts'. Dormancy after 90 days of inactivity may cost 10% of the balance per month (see inactivity fee).

Fee schedule row 'Top-up fees: 5% + $10/new card' — 5% of each top-up (the $10 is the one-time issuance fee, recorded separately). Crypto top-ups also carry a 'conversion spread' (terms, amount not stated).
'FX rates: 1-2%' for non-USD spending; the upper bound is modelled. Terms: 'foreign exchange spreads may apply to non-USD spending'.
No ATM fee or ATM capability is stated on the fee schedule or in the terms for the virtual card.

Terms (27 September 2026): after 90 days of inactivity SolCard 'may, at its discretion' charge 10% of the balance per month; balances under 1 USD may be charged in full. Balances below the 'published minimum refundable amount' are forfeited on card cancellation.

Terms: a 'handling fee' may be charged on cards with a disproportionate number of declined transactions or disputes (amount not stated); 'application, card slot, and top-up fees vary by card type and are shown in the App before confirmation'.

access.note: No monthly or annual fee; 'requires identity verification and removes the top-up fee'; one-time $10 issuance fee per new card (the issuance sentence is general — not stated separately for Platinum). Physical form assumed from the referral page's 'free Platinum card' milestone; form factor not explicit on the fee page.

Inclusion rule of 2026-11-09 met: fees published, verification stage stated per tier ('email-only tier' for Virtual, identity verification for Platinum), product active, no territorial no-solicitation clause. editorial.summary: Prepaid USD Visa cards from a Hong Kong-registered operator (card issuer not disclosed), topped up with crypto. The operator describes the Virtual card as its 'email-only tier' with a $10,000 monthly spending limit, a $10 issuance fee, 5% top-up fee and 1–2% FX; the Platinum card requires identity verification, has no top-up fee, 0–1.5% FX and no spending limit. Not available to Hong Kong residents; no monthly fee, but dormant balances can be charged 10% a month after 90 days.
good_for: Online purchases and subscriptions paid in USD from crypto, where a virtual card suffices
Users who will complete identity verification for the Platinum card to avoid the 5% top-up fee
not_for: Residents of Hong Kong or of sanctioned countries (excluded by the operator)
Cash withdrawals — no ATM capability or fee is published
Anyone who needs a named card issuer or a published country list before trusting a card
watch_outs: The card issuer is not disclosed: the operator states it is 'not a bank, electronic money institution, or card issuer'.
Virtual tier: 5% on every top-up plus $10 per card — expensive for large or frequent loads; the Platinum tier removes the top-up fee but requires identity verification.
Dormancy: after 90 days of inactivity the operator may charge 10% of the balance per month; small residual balances are forfeited on cancellation.
Cashback exists in the terms (expires after 90 days) but no rate is published — nothing is modelled.
FX shown as ranges (1–2%, 0–1.5%); the upper bounds are modelled. A crypto conversion spread of unstated size applies to top-ups.
The $10,000/month limit and 'email-only' wording are the operator's statements; verification 'may be required for certain card tiers, features, or spending limits'.
